name: Curtain Call
source:
Today is graduation day! While everyone else is saying goodbye to their friends or getting ready for their long-awaited break, you spend the day with your drama club. That is, your drama club consisting of two people -- you, and a graduating student. 

After today, the drama club is in your hands. But, for now, let's listen to what the current leader has to say before you say goodbye!

[From [url=https://keropro.itch.io/curtaincall]itch.io[/url]]
